title: 電子計測
subtitle: Electronic Measurement
keywords: SI units 2.Pointer type meter 3.Instrumentation apparatus 4.Digital Instrumentation 5.apparatus
educationalGoal: Electrical and electronic measurements are a way of measuring various electrical quantities. In some cases, it is possible to step out of the world of electronics and measure physical quantities such as length, weight, and speed. In this lecture, the students will learn what the units and measurement terms are and how to apply them. Additionally, they will learn the construction and measurement principles behind major electrical and electronic equipment so that they can understand the fundamentals of electric and electronic measurements.
advice: We will cover the following materials (1) Fundamental Instrumentation SI unit, Standard apparatus, measurement terminology (2) Pointer type meter moving coil type, moving iron type, rectifier type, etc. (3) Electrical instrumentation apparatus Electronic galvanometer, Electronic power meter (4) Digital Instrumentation apparatus digital voltmeter (5) Recording Instrument and waveform measurement Pen recorder, oscilloscope (6) Various electrical quantities instrument Voltage, current, resistor, power, frequency, magnetic field, etc.
requiredKnowledge: All you need to study this subject is to understand the basic electric circuits and basic electromagnetics you have already learned.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the measurement terminology and to used SI unit.
Be able to explain the basic block diagram of electrical instrumentation apparatus(mainly analog type)
Be able to explain the basic block diagram of electrical instrumentation apparatus(mainly digital type)
Be able to explain the various measuring apparatus, oscilloscope, impedance bridge, frequency counter.
Be able to choose the variable measuring apparatus in the intended purpose.

achievementLevels.ideal: ● Be able to sufficiently explain SI units, standard equipment, and terminology required for measurements. ● Be able to sufficiently explain the mechanism and theoretical operation principles of indicator and explain the operations of electronic galvanometer, electric power meter, and digital instrumentation from an electronics aspect. instruments (moving coil, moving iron, rectifier, etc). ●Explain the operating principles and operation methods of various recording based and waveform measurement equipmentand the appropriate measurement equipment selection and operation principles of various electronic variables (voltage, frequency, magnetism).
achievementLevels.standard: ● Explain SI units and required measurement terms. ● Explain the mechanism and operation principles of various basic indicator instruments (analog coil instruments such as moving coil, moving iron, and commutating instruments). ● Describe the fundamental operations of basic electronic instruments (electronic galvanometer, digital instruments, etc) ● Explain the operation principles and methods of various recording and waveform measurement equipment. ● Explain how to select the appropriate equipment when measuring various amounts of electricity.

lessons.content: Course introduction and self introduction of the teacher. Fundamental measuring technique SI unit. Self-check
Pointer type meter(analog type) moving coil type, moving iron type, rectifier type, etc. Self-check
Block diagram of the typical electronic measuring system(anolog type). electric-galvanometer, power meter Self-check
lessons.operation: Quiz and review Lecture and practice Q & A

lessons.content: Block diagram of the typical electronic measuring system(degital type). DVM(Digital Volt Meter) Self-check
Recording Instrument measurement. The operation principle of pen recorder principle. Self-check
Waveform measurement. The operation principle of Oscilloscope. Self-check
lessons.operation: Quiz Lecture and practice Q & A

lessons.content: Oscilloscope principle. Trigger sweep, saw tooth waveform. Principle of the waveform rests on the screen. Self-check
Various measuring methods of the voltage and current. Very low voltage and current value. Self-check
Measuring methods of register value Block diagram of circuit tester Self-check
lessons.operation: Quiz Lecture and practice Q & A

lessons.content: DC and AC power measurement and equipment
Principle of electric frequency counter Self-check
Measuring method of the impedance, capacitance and inductance using the impedance bridge apparatus. Self-check
